parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: The code of the configuration item. You can call the [DescribeConfigs](~~DescribeConfigs~~) operation to obtain the code of the configuration item.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh_cn**: Chinese (default)
*   **en_us**: English

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp disable-user-config --lang zh_cn --code access_failed_cnt --feature-type 2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sddp DisableUserConfig --region cn-hangzhou --FeatureType 2 --Lang zh_cn --Code access_failed_cnt
